claim: Continuous file synchronization between two or more computers
Does not upload data to the cloud; exchanges data as soon as devices are online at the same time
At first start generates config file and encryption keys and starts the admin GUI in the browser; single syncthing binary
Docker README exists; community GUI wrappers
Release binaries are GPG signed; macOS and Windows binaries code-signed
Not a great backup application: changes and deletions propagate to all devices; versioning can be enabled
What is synced: contents, mtimes; optionally permissions, owners, xattrs. Not synced: hard links, Windows ACLs, resource forks
Blocks are fetched from all devices in parallel
Goals ordered: safe from data loss, secure, easy to use
Android and other community flavors run the same core
